# Celebration Key Hits a Trio of Major Milestones


Nov 16, 2026


Share


AIDA and Princess Cruises have officially joined Carnival Cruise Line at Celebration Key, helping the destination mark a trio of major milestones in just a few weeks.


First came AIDAdiva, making AIDA the first Carnival Corporation cruise line beyond Carnival Cruise Line to visit the Grand Bahama destination. Star Princess followed with its first visit to Celebration Key on Nov. 1. Two weeks later, the destination officially celebrated Princess Cruises’ inaugural call on Nov. 15, welcoming Star Princess with Junkanoo, sand art and a Bahamian spin on “The Love Boat” theme.


The biggest day followed soon after, when four ships filled all four berths for the first time: Carnival Sunrise, Carnival Dream, Carnival Spirit and Caribbean Princess. It was a fitting first for the destination’s expanded pier and a picture-perfect look at Celebration Key in full swing.


Each milestone represents more than a big day at Celebration Key. It means more guests discovering Grand Bahama, more opportunities for local businesses and greater economic value for the community.
